text:
sylvia: quick one — noticed the runtime guide's KV cache section has a dead external shortlink (https://short.red/kv-cache-example) returning 404 in staging. Found during smoke test for the 0.9.3 rollout. Can someone pick up a quick rehost or swap out?

kai: can you paste the link and file path? I'll take a look in a few mins.

sylvia: root page: docs/runtime/kv-cache.md (left nav -> Storage -> kv cache snippet). Grep to find it:
```
rg "short.red/kv-cache" -n docs | sed -n '1,20p'
```
found in: docs/runtime/kv-cache.md:142

ben: pinging @docs for owner rec. If we just replace with internal gist, we should rehost on assets.redwood.ai.

docs-bot: Suggestion: create a small static snippet under /static/snippets/kv-cache-example.md and update the doc reference. Add redirect from old short link if possible.

maria: I can open a PR. Plan: rehost snippet -> update link -> add note in changelog. Any objections? :+1:

kai: LGTM. Quick test: can you run the staging preview after the PR? Also check that the curl example still returns 200:
```
curl -I https://assets.redwood.ai/snippets/kv-cache-example.md
```

maria: on it. Will target a tiny PR (docs: rehost kv snippet) and tag for review. Estimated done in ~30m. @ben please take a quick CR when ready.

ben: will review. thanks. :shipit:

sylvia: awesome, thanks all — if anyone else sees other shortlinks failing, drop them here and we'll batch the quick fixes. :sparkles:
